newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes Chemical sees flat '97 performance.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes Chemical sees flat '97 performance.

text.p: Great Lakes Chemical Corp said Wednesday it sees financial performance in 1997 about flat with 1996, although cash flow from operations is expected to be at record levels.
The company has received unspecified one-time fees for a failed acquisition attempt and for divestment of a subsidiary, Great Lakes said.
Through the first nine months of 1996, Great Lakes has reported net income of $212.5 million on sales of $1.7 billion.
"Overall, we expect operating income from specialty chemicals businesses to be up double-digit 1997 over 1996," McDonald said.
But McDonald said he expected lower earnigns from the company's tetraethyl lead business, saying the rate of volume decline in retail markets for antiknock compound seen this year will continue.
Great Lakes shares fell 2-1/2 to 52-7/8 Wednesday.
